ABOUT BLU CAPITAL

Financial support that opens doors.

A non-traditional financial company focused on helping businesses find a path to growth.

OUR BEGINNINGS

History

We began in Mexico in 2013 as a family business providing financial support to small businesses. By finding practical answers to customers’ needs and building relationships based on mutual trust, our business expanded.

WHY WE ARE HERE

Mission

Our mission is to provide quality invoice factoring and financial services to small businesses across America and Mexico. We connect businesses of different kinds with new opportunities through a straightforward, helpful experience.
